title: The Bloodsand Chest
text:
Something worth fighting over in the arena, and a round of PvP fixes.

✨ The Bloodsand Chest: a war chest appears in the middle of the Bloodsand Arena every 3 minutes. Opening it takes 3 seconds of standing still, and any hit or step breaks it, so you will have to fight for it. Whoever opens it first gets +50 Conquest and +75 Honor. The arena panel shows when the next chest is due and who took the last one
• Arcanist: Phoenix Flame is replaced by Arcane Barrier, a shield that absorbs damage equal to 40% of your maximum health for 12 seconds (30 second cooldown). Pyromancy now strengthens Meteor and Arcane Barrier
✨ Absorb shields (Arcane Barrier, Celestus shields and rallying cries) now show as a shimmering bubble around the hero
🔧 Vile Poisons now poisons enemy players too, in the arena and Emberclash Fields
🔧 A Shade in stealth now stays hidden from enemies everywhere in the arena and the battleground, including from players standing in safe areas. Only party members and battleground teammates can see them
🔧 Stealthing no longer makes the chat claim that a player has left or entered the realm
✨ New achievement: Spoils of the Sands
